content.hero_subtitle: Professional text formatting with four essential conversion modes.
content.p1: Our Case Converter is a comprehensive text transformation utility designed for efficiency and precision. Whether you need to fix "accidental caps lock" mistakes, format titles for a blog post, or ensure proper sentence structure in a legacy document, this tool provides instant results with zero complexity. It handles large blocks of text gracefully and executes all logic locally for maximum performance and privacy.

upper.title: UPPERCASE
upper.desc: Converts every character to its capital form. Ideal for headings and emphasis.

lower.title: lowercase
lower.desc: Converts all characters to small letters. Perfect for cleaning up input data.

title.title: Title Case
title.desc: Capitalizes the first letter of every word. Standard for headlines and book titles.

sentence.title: Sentence Case
sentence.desc: Capitalizes only the first letter of each sentence. Follows standard prose rules.

caps.title: Fixing Caps Lock
caps.desc: Instantly repair text accidentally typed with the caps lock key turned on.

tips_list.1: UPPERCASE is best used sparingly for short alerts or design-heavy UI elements.
tips_list.2: Sentence Case is the most readable format for long paragraphs and descriptions.
tips_list.3: Always use the "Copy to Clipboard" button to avoid manual selection errors.
tips_list.4: Combine our Case Converter with a word counter for complete editing control.
tips_list.5: Use case conversion to maintain consistency across your codebase and improve code readability.

faq.q1: Is there a limit to how much text I can convert?
faq.a1: No. Our tool uses optimized JavaScript that can handle thousands of lines of text in milliseconds.
faq.q2: Do you store my text on your servers?
faq.a2: Never. All conversions happen entirely within your web browser. Your data is private and never transmitted.
faq.q3: What is the difference between Title Case and Sentence Case?
faq.a3: Title Case capitalizes the first letter of every word, while Sentence Case only capitalizes the first letter of each sentence.
faq.q4: Does this work on mobile devices?
faq.a4: Yes! The responsive design ensures a seamless experience on smartphones, tablets, and desktops.
faq.q5: Does it handle special characters and accents?
faq.a5: Yes, our converter supports standard UTF-8 characters, preserving accents and symbols while changing letter case.
